nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Cars are parked along both sides of the alley. There's a skip on the left and a drainage channel on the right.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: At the far end, there's a gate in a fence. No building beyond it, just the ground carrying on. A textbook case of “Thomas architecture.”

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You walked the alley between the flats. There is a gate at the end of it.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Nobody's here. The gate isn't locked, but somehow getting through it doesn't seem straightforward.
